embeds.title: PSBL SCOUTING
embeds.description: One forum for every prospect: the minors, college, international signings, the MLB Draft and the PSBL draft.

fields.name: HOW IT WORKS
fields.value: Make one post per player or topic, and search before you post so each prospect keeps one thread. Add tags for the league, the player's status and position.

fields.name: TAGS
fields.value:
**Level:** AAA • AA • HIGH-A • LOW-A • ROOKIE • COLLEGE • INTERNATIONAL • MLB DRAFT
**Status:** TOP PROSPECT • SLEEPER • RISER • FALLER • MLB READY • LONG SHOT
**Position:** HITTER • PITCHER
**PSBL draft:** PSBL DRAFT • RANKINGS • MOCK DRAFT

fields.name: MINOR-LEAGUE RULES
fields.value: Minor-league spots are for players with no more than 130 career MLB at-bats and no more than 50 career MLB innings pitched (MLB's rookie limits; no age limit). Details are in Article VII.

fields.name: THE PSBL DRAFT
fields.value: 5 rounds, linear order, starting between January 20 and February 10; the first Annual Draft is in 2028. The pool is any unowned player who qualifies for a minor-league spot, not just the MLB Draft class (Article XIV). Official draft notices are in the Draft Center.

fields.name: NEWS FEED
fields.value: Automated prospect news appears in **🌱│prospect-wire**. Come here to talk about what it means.
